name: First Bite: Bad Blood
source:
[b]So you think you’re above the law because you’re undead and have perfect hair?[/b]

Think again.

In FIRST BITE: BAD BLOOD, begin your life as a creature of the night and discover that being a vampire isn’t just all great sex and free meals. 

Pick up where you left off as Noe, a freshly turned vampire adjusting to immortality with your new family. But things aren’t quite as simple as you hoped when you’re being eased into vampire life by a murder-himbo obsessed with Eurodance, a narcissist with an online shopping addiction, and a wild card with a penchant for BDSM. 

When Very Important Emails from the Council of Vampires the trio blissfully ignored come back to bite them in the form of an old flame with a thirst for more than just timely filed paperwork, you’ll need to prove that your existence is justified, or prepare to meet your maker… 

For real this time.

[Edited from [url=https://www.firstbitegames.com/badblood]official website[/url]]
translation:
[b]所以你认为你可以凌驾于法律之上，因为你是不死族并且拥有完美的头发？[/b]再想一想。

在《第一口：坏血》中，你将开始作为夜间生物的生活，并发现成为吸血鬼不仅仅意味着美妙的性爱和免费的食物。

继续扮演诺伊，一个刚变成吸血鬼的人，与你的新家庭一起适应永生。但事情并不像你希望的那么简单，当你被一个沉迷于欧洲舞曲的谋杀狂人、一个沉迷于网购的自恋者和一个沉迷于BDSM的外卡所带入吸血鬼生活时。

当吸血鬼委员会发来的非常重要的电子邮件被三人幸福地忽略时，他们会以旧情人的形式回来咬他们，而他们不仅仅渴望及时提交的文件，你需要证明你的存在是合理的，或者准备好去见你的创造者…… 

这次是真的。
